brand.name: sonarly
brand.tagline: Your music. Your disk. Any client.
brand.sector: self-hosted music streaming and collection management

sentence.en: Sonarly indexes the music folder you already have and serves it through the OpenSubsonic API, so any Subsonic client works — and your files stay on your disk, in your folder structure, exactly where you left them.

set.name: Night Sweep
set.mechanism: The OLED stage at night: a thin dial track, one thick chartreuse beam sweeping it, and the dot the beam finds — wide tracked capitals on a black that stays black.
set.expression_move: The chartreuse beam is the only bright thing in the room.
set.differs_by: Jellyfin and Navidrome own friendly blues, Plex magenta, Ampache orange; none owns a phosphor lime beam on OLED black.

logo.concept: A night dial: a thin track, one thick beam sweeping it, and the dot the sweep finds — playback as the lit part of the room.
logo.defect: Track ring filled as two discs: same sweep-flag bug as set A — the inner return arc swept the short way; fixed to sweep 1. Small-mark beam also had both arc sweeps inverted.

rationale.claim: Beam Lime #C8F04B is CIE76 54+ from every measured competitor primary, and lime is vivid only at high lightness (OKLCH L 0.87) — which suits an accent that lives on dark grounds.
Funnel Display passes the tnum gate (tabular by default), so play counts and statistics stay aligned even when set in the display face.
An open track arc plus one thick beam avoids the music category's clichés (play-button triangle, equalizer bars, vinyl disc) that were named before drawing.
OLED Black #0B0D10 keeps chroma at 0.008 so the ground stays neutral black rather than navy, and the track renders in near-white on it.

findings.message: light: primary #c8f04b on background #ffffff is 1.31:1, below 3.0:1 (primary fill against the page (needs a label or border if lower); WCAG 2, no rounding)
light: accent #c8f04b on background #ffffff is 1.31:1, below 3.0:1 (accent fill against the page (needs a label or border if lower); WCAG 2, no rounding)
dark: link and text collapse to CIEDE2000 5.0 for tritanopia (#dae1e5 vs #f2f3f4)

suggested_fix.how: never carry meaning by colour alone (icon/label); or darken by OKLCH L -0.18, same hue

findings.message: light: border #e4e6e9 on background #ffffff is 1.25:1, below 3.0:1 (borders: dividers are exempt, input outlines need 3:1; WCAG 2, no rounding)
dark: link #c8f04b on text #f2f3f5 is 1.18:1, below 3.0:1 (underline links in dark mode (WCAG G183: without underline a link needs 3:1 against body text); WCAG 2, no rounding)
dark: border #3a424d on background #0b0d10 is 1.91:1, below 3.0:1 (borders: dividers are exempt, input outlines need 3:1; WCAG 2, no rounding)
